input.question: Where is Unity Christian High School located?

documents.text: Barrie. Unity started with only grades 9 and 10, and has added a year every two semesters until reaching its current 4 grades, 9-12. It had its first graduation at the conclusion of the 2007/8 school year. Unity purchased 25 Burton Ave., previously King Edward Public School, in April 2010. They began to hold classes in the building in September 2010. Unity Christian High School (Barrie) Unity Christian High School (commonly Unity Christian, UCHS, or UNITY) is a Christian private secondary school in Barrie, Ontario, Canada, serving students in grades 9–12.
